R57 adapter court executed 50/50 PASS and observes four consumer families, two full-adapter-ready, shortfall eight to adapter-ready factor 10. R58 independently distinguishes ALIVE consumer execution and reports one independently ALIVE consumer of four, shortfall nine to factor 10. Highest lawful edges are: manufacture a canonical deterministic consumer-adapter factory from the existing R57 plan/gap substrate; realize the admitted-but-not-independent target consumers without duplicating producer courts; return exact consumer receipts through R50/R52 lineage; measure R54 independence and downstream composition/yield. Preserve ex4pm, GymAct, ggen and cloud consumer options until exact target evidence selects their family-specific projections. 1000X remains NOT_ADMITTED.
